needs.proposedSignature: `AltCost.id` gains `'miracle'`: `{ id: 'miracle', label: 'miracle', cost: { mana: ManaCost }, from: 'hand' }`; `COVER_RULES.altCosts.lines` gains `^miracle (\{.+\})$` whose value check is `altCost.cost.mana.raw` against the printed symbols; `KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS.miracle = 'when you draw ~, if it is the first card you drew this turn, you may reveal it. when you do, you may cast it for {cost}'`
needs.semantics: Miracle (CR 702.94): as you draw the FIRST card you drew this turn you may reveal it from your hand; that reveal creates a triggered ability, and as it resolves you may cast the card for its miracle cost. The alternative-cost machinery already casts a card for a different cost, so the engine work is the reveal-on-draw replacement plus the first-card-this-turn gate (`cards-drawn-this-turn` already exists as an Amount count). For a script AUTHOR the missing halves are the `altCosts` id and the covers shape: today a printed `Miracle {cost}` line is claimable by nothing at all — no altCost, no covers kind, and no keyword rules text to score an expanded ability against — so seven otherwise-finished cards in this batch alone cannot be fullyParsed.
